title: Distinguish evaluator scope changes from evidence-read infrastructure failures
outcome: An unfinished captured-evidence recovery tells the requester when a changed evaluator scope requires a fresh evaluation and when the Engram or host read infrastructure failed.
acceptance: A real recovery-path fixture proves that moved captured work or run identity yields a distinct scope-change diagnostic while a tracker timeout stays an evaluator infrastructure failure. Both paths remain no-verdict outcomes and recover only through an appropriate fresh evaluation.
